root_causes.description: Extreme memory usage spike (z=+8.97, window=1.395e+08 bytes) far exceeding all other services. Payment service memory consumption is abnormally high, likely causing pressure downstream.
Extreme p99 latency spike (z>1000, window=2.307ms) the most anomalous signal across all services, indicating quote service is experiencing severe latency degradation.
High p99 latency spike (z=+6.98, window=29.4ms) product-catalog service showing significant latency degradation, which per topology depends on product-catalog and is called by checkout and frontend.

remediation_steps: Investigate payment service memory consumption - check for memory leaks, OOM killer events, or unbounded data structures. Consider restarting payment pods after identifying the root cause.

Investigate quote service latency - check for downstream dependency issues, database performance degradation, or circuit breaker failures. Add circuit breaking and timeout configurations if not already in place.
Investigate product-catalog latency - validate database query performance and cache hit rates. Consider implementing read replicas or query optimization.
